item.aicompanion.death_note.tooltip: Write a human's name here, and that human dies.
aicompanion.msg.no_key: Ryuk is silent: he needs an AI key.
aicompanion.msg.voice_error: [AI Companion] Ryuk's voice doesn't work: %s (see the play guide)
aicompanion.note.fell: Something black fell out of the sky nearby. A notebook?
aicompanion.note.fell_again: Another black notebook dropped out of the sky nearby.
aicompanion.note.still_lies: The black notebook still lies where it fell, near x %s, z %s. Its outline shows through walls.
aicompanion.case.title: CASES
aicompanion.case.wanted_none: • nobody yet: the news comes every morning
aicompanion.case.first: • Write the name of someone whose face you've seen: the news is full of them.
aicompanion.case.tv: • No TV, no news. Craft one (5 iron ingots and a black dye) and keep it on you: while it's in your inventory, the news comes by itself.
aicompanion.case.kira_wins: • Kira has won. A new world.
aicompanion.case.broadcast: • A special on every channel: "L" addresses Kira, the caption says Lind L. Tailor. His face is on every screen, and the broadcast ends soon.
aicompanion.case.hq: • L's headquarters: %s, %s. Ryuzaki waits in the main hall, one floor up. Watari keeps the files on the top floor.
aicompanion.case.agents: • An FBI agent is tailing you. Scared, he may flash his badge, and his real name with it.
aicompanion.case.cameras: • The Task Force searched your house: there may be cameras by the bed.
aicompanion.case.hideout: • The mafia hideout, Sidoh's notebook: %s, %s. Down the tunnel in the shack. The boss reads names off faces: hide yours.
aicompanion.case.hideout_mello: • The mafia hideout, Mello: %s, %s. Down the tunnel in the shack.
aicompanion.case.hostage: • Mello holds a hostage there: a notebook by sunset, or the hostage dies.
aicompanion.case.meeting: • The Yellow Box warehouse: %s, %s. Near waits at dawn.
aicompanion.note.rule1: The human whose name is written here dies, but only if the writer has their face in mind.
aicompanion.note.rule2: Only the true name works; aliases do nothing. A creature answers to the name a human gave it.
aicompanion.note.rule3: No cause written: the heart stops 40 seconds later. A cause written with the name happens: fire, a fall, lightning, drowning, an explosion, freezing, an illness. For someone far away (a criminal from the news) the notebook will do anything you write.
aicompanion.note.rule4: A time of death may be set ("in 10 minutes"), up to 23 days ahead.
aicompanion.note.rule5: What is written can't be erased. The death can't be undone.
aicompanion.note.rule6: It doesn't work on humans younger than 780 days, or with less than 12 minutes left to live.
aicompanion.note.rule7: Misspell the same person's name four times, and the notebook can't touch them any more.
aicompanion.note.rule8: A torn-out page works just like the notebook.
aicompanion.note.rule9: A human who uses this notebook will go to neither heaven nor hell.
aicompanion.note.rule10: If the owner writes no name for 13 days in a row, the owner dies.
aicompanion.note.rule11: If this notebook is torn up or burned, everyone who ever touched it dies.
aicompanion.note.name: name:
aicompanion.note.game_on: Accepted. There is no way back.
aicompanion.deal.title: THE EYE DEAL
aicompanion.deal.text1: Ryuk will give you the eyes of a god of death: over every human you look at, you will see their true name and how long they have left to live.
aicompanion.deal.text2: The price is half of the life you have left. You won't learn how much that was, or how much remains. A deal can't be undone.
aicompanion.deal.again: You already have the eyes. Another deal takes half of what's left again.
aicompanion.deal.note: The eyes need to see a face. They don't show the lifespans of Death Note owners, and never your own.
aicompanion.eyelook.title: THE EYES OF A GOD OF DEATH
aicompanion.eyelook.text: Mark where the eyes are on your face: those pixels will glow red. Found on your skin already; fix it if it's off.
aicompanion.eyelook.hint: Left click: bright. Right click: dim. The same click again, or Shift: off. Drag the head to turn it.
aicompanion.pact.title: RYUK'S GAME
aicompanion.pact.intro: Ryuk promised: when your time comes, he will write your name himself. He is bored, so he offers a game with stakes. Its rules:
aicompanion.pact.rule1: When your life runs out, Ryuk writes your name. You don't know how much is left, and every eye deal takes half of it.
aicompanion.pact.rule2: Write your own name, and you die.
aicompanion.pact.rule3: If L proves that you are Kira, the game is lost: Ryuk writes your name.
aicompanion.pact.rule4: Don't let Ryuk get bored. Apples and a good show keep him entertained.
aicompanion.pact.stakes_delete: Lose, and you die for good: no respawn, and this world is deleted when you leave it.
aicompanion.pact.stakes_ghost: Lose, and you die for good: no respawn. You stay in this world only as a ghost.
aicompanion.pact.note: Without the game the same things happen, but you come back after death. A refusal can be changed later on the notebook's last page; an acceptance is forever.
aicompanion.mu.title: MU
aicompanion.mu.why.TIME: Your lifespan ran out. Ryuk wrote your name, as he had promised.
aicompanion.mu.why.CAUGHT: L proved that you are Kira. The game was lost, and Ryuk wrote your name.
aicompanion.mu.why.BORED: Ryuk got bored. He wrote your name.
aicompanion.mu.text: There is no heaven and no hell. Whoever dies goes to Mu: nothing. You won't come back.
aicompanion.mu.leave_delete: Leave. This world will be deleted
aicompanion.mu.ghost: Stay and watch as a ghost
block.aicompanion.hidden_drawer.tooltip: Opens on a decoy diary. Right-click it with an ink sac in hand: the false bottom, 9 slots no search finds. Break it and everything inside burns.
item.aicompanion.scrap.chips: A page in a bag of chips
item.aicompanion.scrap.page.tooltip: A piece of the notebook kills just like it. Witnesses notice it only up close.
item.aicompanion.scrap.watch.tooltip: Pull the crown four times, fast. The name goes in blood.
item.aicompanion.scrap.chips.tooltip: A mini TV and a scrap inside. The cameras film somebody eating chips.
aicompanion.agent.badge: The man who has been following you flashes a badge: "FBI! Stay behind me!" The name on it: %s
aicompanion.tv.special: SPECIAL on every channel: L addresses Kira. The caption says Lind L. Tailor.
aicompanion.tv.tailor1: I am L, the only one who can find the one you call Kira.
aicompanion.tv.tailor2: Kira, I know what you're doing. You call it justice.
aicompanion.tv.tailor4: Whatever your reasons, what you are doing is evil.
aicompanion.tv.tailor6: You can't hide from me forever.
aicompanion.tv.tailor7: Every death leaves a trace, and I follow every one of them.
aicompanion.tv.tailor8: This broadcast ends soon. Think about what you've done.
aicompanion.tv.no_bait: Kira didn't take the bait. Interesting. You are more careful than I thought.
aicompanion.tv.quiet: Sakura TV: no breaking news, nobody wanted on air right now.
aicompanion.tv.tailor_died: Lind L. Tailor clutches his chest and falls face down on the desk, live on air. The cameras keep rolling.
aicompanion.tv.l1: It can't be... I had to test it, but I didn't quite believe it. Kira, you really exist.
aicompanion.tv.l2: The man you just killed was Lind L. Tailor, a criminal due to be executed today. It wasn't me.
aicompanion.tv.l3: This broadcast went out to one region only. So you are here, Kira.
aicompanion.tv.l4: And you kill without coming near: all you need is a face and a name.
aicompanion.tv.l5: I am L. Try to kill me, if you can.
aicompanion.card.tv_hint_text: Sakura TV shows the names and faces of the wanted. Craft a television: 5 iron ingots + a black dye. It's a small one: keep it in your inventory and the news comes by itself; right-click with it in hand to see what's on now.
aicompanion.show.speaker: Lind L. Tailor
aicompanion.show.l_end: L knows: Kira is in this region and kills with a face and a name. Now he's looking for you.
aicompanion.tv.wanted: Sakura TV News: police are hunting %s, wanted for %s. The face fills the screen.
aicompanion.crime3: the murder of a family of three
aicompanion.crime7: swindling pensioners out of their savings
aicompanion.tv.died_heart: Breaking: %s, the wanted man, has been found dead. A heart attack.
aicompanion.tv.died_fire: Breaking: %s, the wanted man, burned to death in his hideout.
aicompanion.tv.died_fall: Breaking: %s, the wanted man, fell from a roof while running from the police.
aicompanion.tv.died_lightning: Breaking: %s, the wanted man, was struck by lightning out of a clear sky.
aicompanion.tv.kira_named: Sakura TV: criminals across the region keep dying, one after another. The net already has a name for whoever is behind it: Kira. Some call it murder, some call it justice.
aicompanion.l.arrest: "I am L." The Task Force closes in around you. The evidence is complete.
aicompanion.l.confiscated: The Task Force took the notebook (%s). Without Ryuk's game, that is all you lost.
aicompanion.rumour1: Have you heard? People keep dying of heart attacks. They're calling it Kira.
aicompanion.rumour2: Kira only punishes the wicked... doesn't he?
aicompanion.rumour3: My cousin says a detective is on the case. Nobody has ever seen his face.
aicompanion.rumour4: If Kira is a god, I'm praying to him tonight.
aicompanion.rumour5: Strange times. Nobody's safe, if they have a face and a name.
aicompanion.rumour6: They say L has never lost a case.
aicompanion.talk.tailor: I am L. Kira, I will find you.
aicompanion.talk.agent: Me? Just passing through. The name's %s.
aicompanion.talk.detective1: %s, police. We're on the Kira case. Seen anything unusual?
aicompanion.talk.detective2: Every one of them died of a heart attack. Criminals, mostly. Strange, isn't it?
aicompanion.talk.detective3: If you hear anything about Kira, the police would like to know.
aicompanion.talk.detective.hq1: %s, Task Force. Ryuzaki is in the main hall, one floor up. He's expecting you.
aicompanion.talk.detective.hq2: He lives on cake and sugar cubes, and he's never wrong. Well, almost never.
aicompanion.talk.detective.hq3: Cameras on every floor. Ryuzaki trusts nobody, not even us.
aicompanion.talk.detective.watari_dead1: Watari is dead. Ryuzaki hasn't said a word about it, but he hasn't touched his cake either.
aicompanion.talk.detective.watari_dead2: Every file went with Watari. We're starting the case over from nothing.
aicompanion.talk.detective.l_dead1: Ryuzaki is dead. His heart just... stopped. Kira got him.
aicompanion.talk.detective.l_dead2: We left his chair as it was. Nobody can bring themselves to sit in it.
aicompanion.talk.detective.l_dead3: Without him we're just police in an empty tower. But we're not giving up.
aicompanion.talk.detective.near1: Ryuzaki is gone. A boy from his orphanage took over the case: Near. We report to the SPK now.
aicompanion.talk.detective.near2: Near never leaves his room full of toys, and yet he knows more than we do.
aicompanion.talk.detective.near3: His chair is still in the main hall. Nobody had the heart to move it.
aicompanion.talk.watari1: Ryuzaki is busy. Some tea? I'm %s.
aicompanion.talk.watari2: He takes his tea with eight sugar cubes. At least.
aicompanion.talk.watari3: Please don't disturb him while he thinks. Which is always.
aicompanion.talk.watari.l_dead1: Ryuzaki... is gone. I'll see his work through, as long as I'm able.
aicompanion.talk.watari.l_dead2: Tea? Forgive me. I keep making two cups.
aicompanion.talk.mafia3: Looking for someone? The door's behind you.
aicompanion.hq.invite: Excuse me! Ryuzaki would like to meet you at the headquarters, at %s, %s. Through the metal check, then the stairs one floor up to the main hall. He said it's about... a case.
aicompanion.hq.metal: [Security] Metal detected. Leave all metal items in the lockers and walk through again.
aicompanion.hq.file1: WAMMY'S HOUSE, WINCHESTER. Records of the first generation. Confidential: these pages never leave this room.
aicompanion.hq.file2:
L. True name: L Lawliet. Never written, never spoken.

- Q. W.
aicompanion.mafia.stare: The boss looks you straight in the face. His eyes flash red...
aicompanion.mafia.wrote: The boss scribbles in a black notebook, eyes on you. Your heart skips a beat.
aicompanion.drawer.decoy: Just an ordinary diary inside. Nothing to see here... only a tiny hole in the side panel.
aicompanion.drawer.burned: The drawer flares up: a spark, a bag of gasoline. Whatever lay inside is ash.
aicompanion.sidoh.line1: Th-that's my notebook! Please... give it back to me!
aicompanion.sidoh.line2: If I go home without it, the King will... he'll punish me!
aicompanion.sidoh.line3: I'll do anything! I'll even tell you a secret about the rules!
aicompanion.sidoh.line5: D-do you have any chocolate? No? Oh...
aicompanion.sidoh.thanks: Thank you, thank you! Listen, here's the secret: the two rules at the back of that notebook, the thirteen days and the burned notebook... Ryuk made them up! They're lies!
aicompanion.sidoh.visible: As your fingers close on the notebook, you see him: a trembling god of death wrapped in bandages, with a little yellow beak. Sidoh.
aicompanion.sidoh.mask: Something invisible tears the mask off your head!
aicompanion.sidoh.mask_seen: Sidoh, shaking, tears the mask off your head: "S-sorry! He makes me!"
aicompanion.mafia.ledger1: Payments, shipments, debts. The passport tucked between the pages says Jack Neylon.
aicompanion.mafia.ledger2: Every page is signed the same way, in a heavy hand: K. Snydar. Kal Snydar.
aicompanion.realm.enter: You fall asleep... and the world goes grey. Bones, chains, ash in the air. Ryuk's world.
aicompanion.realm.wake: You wake up in your bed, cold. It was only a dream... wasn't it?
aicompanion.realm.king: Something vast stirs in its chains above you. A skull within a skull turns your way... The King of Death has seen you. You feel very, very small.
aicompanion.realm.vision: You look into the hole and think of %s: they are %s (%s).
aicompanion.realm.vision_none: You look into the hole, but no face comes to mind.
aicompanion.realm.bet: Gook taps the bowl: an apple first, human.
aicompanion.realm.win: The bones fall your way! Deridovely groans and pays you two apples.
aicompanion.realm.lose: The bones fall badly. Gook snatches your apple and cackles.
aicompanion.realm.armonia1: Whoever owns a notebook sees its god of death. Touch another notebook, and you see that one's god too.
aicompanion.realm.armonia2: Half of your remaining life buys the eyes. The deal may be made again; the years never come back.
aicompanion.realm.armonia3: A god of death who kills to save a human he favours turns to dust. Remember Gelus. Remember Rem.
aicompanion.realm.armonia4: No more than six notebooks may be in the human world at once.
aicompanion.realm.armonia5: Only the god of death bound to a notebook may write its owner's name. Ryuk will keep his promise.
aicompanion.realm.gambler1: Toss the bones, human. Your apple against my bones.
aicompanion.realm.gambler2: Heh. Ryuk brought apples down here once. Now everyone wants them.
aicompanion.realm.gambler3: Sleep, gamble, watch the humans. That's all there is to do here.
aicompanion.realm.gambler4: Don't stare like that. Are you even supposed to be here?
item.aicompanion.realm_apple.desc: Shrivelled and dark, it tastes of sand. But whoever eats it senses every life around for a moment.
aicompanion.realm.apple: You pick an apple off a dead branch. It's light as an empty shell.
aicompanion.realm.apple_again: No more within reach. New ones will grow by the next dream.
aicompanion.realm.apple_eaten: Dry as sand... But for a moment you sense every life around you, as a god of death does.
aicompanion.realm.armonia_tribute: The years never come back... unless the King judges otherwise. Thirteen apples in the bowl at his feet, and he can be generous to a mortal.
aicompanion.realm.bowl_empty: A bowl at the King's feet. Empty. Armonia knows what it's for.
aicompanion.realm.bowl_apples: Tribute to the King: %s/%s. Put apples in: right-click with apples in hand.
aicompanion.realm.bowl_done: The King has already taken your tribute.
aicompanion.voice.silence: Silence: the microphone is off or too quiet
aicompanion.renounce.forget: You blink. What were you doing just now? Something about... no. Nothing. There was nothing.
aicompanion.renounce.remember: Your fingers touch the black cover, and it all comes flooding back: the notebook, Ryuk, every name you wrote.
aicompanion.near.arrive: appears on every screen: "L is dead, but the case is not closed. From today it is mine. Kira, I will find you." (the SPK base: %s, %s)
aicompanion.near.invite: on every screen: "Kira. Let's end this. Come to the Yellow Box warehouse at dawn (%s, %s). If you don't come, I will take that as your answer."
aicompanion.near.early: You're early. We begin at dawn. I'll finish my tower meanwhile.
aicompanion.near.showdown1: So you came. Everyone in this warehouse has shown you their face. Kira needs only that, and a name.
aicompanion.near.showdown2: Go on, if you like. Write. We'll wait the forty seconds together.
aicompanion.near.showdown3: L, Kira... and me. (He sets three finger puppets in a row.) Only one of us is left standing at the end.
aicompanion.near.copy: Forty seconds. Nobody died. The notebook you wrote in is a copy: Gevanni replaced it days ago. The real one is here, with every name you wrote. You are Kira.
aicompanion.near.proof: Nothing? Then I'll show you. This notebook was taken from your house and copied. Every name in it is one you wrote. You are Kira.
aicompanion.near.deaths: They died right in front of me, forty seconds after you came. That is all the proof I need. You are Kira.
aicompanion.near.not_today: No proof today. I can wait. I'll be watching every name, every death.
aicompanion.near.no_show: Kira didn't come. That is an answer too. It's over, Kira.
aicompanion.near.mello_lead: Mello is dead... but he left me what I needed. Thank you, Mello.
aicompanion.mello.demand: I have %s. Bring me a Death Note before the next sunset and the hostage walks. My place is %s. Don't be late.
aicompanion.mello.deal: Smart. The hostage walks. And this notebook is mine now.
aicompanion.mello.spk_hit: Within the hour the mob turns the notebook on the SPK: Near loses people and time.
aicompanion.mello.freed: With Mello dead, his men let the hostage go.
aicompanion.talk.spk1: %s, SPK. We have nothing to discuss with you. Yet.
aicompanion.talk.spk2: Near is busy. Near is always busy.
aicompanion.talk.mello1: Got chocolate? No? Then get lost.
aicompanion.talk.mello2: Near sits with his toys while I do the real work.
aicompanion.talk.mello3: Kira, L, Near... I'll beat them all. My way.
aicompanion.talk.mello.hostage1: I'll say it again: a Death Note before sunset, or the hostage doesn't see the morning.
aicompanion.talk.mello.hostage2: Tick tock. Put the notebook in my hand, then we talk.
aicompanion.talk.mello.chocolate: *snaps off a piece* Fine, a tip for the chocolate: Near's people go through houses at night. Don't leave your notebook by your bed.
aicompanion.kira.wins: Near is dead. L is dead. Nobody is left to hunt Kira. This world is yours now.
aicompanion.cine.epilogue.title: THE NEW WORLD
aicompanion.cine.epilogue.sub: Nobody is left to hunt Kira
aicompanion.cine.village.1.title: THE WORLD CHANGES
aicompanion.cine.village.1.sub: a shrine to Kira in every village
aicompanion.cine.village.2.title: KIRA IS JUSTICE
aicompanion.cine.village.2.sub: people pray to their new god
aicompanion.cine.village.3.title: EVIL HIDES
aicompanion.cine.village.3.sub: criminals are afraid to leave their homes
aicompanion.cine.end.title: THE NEW WORLD
aicompanion.cine.end.sub: the story is over · the world goes on
aicompanion.tv.kira2: L is dead. So is his successor. Everyone who hunted me has lost.
aicompanion.tv.kira3: From now on everyone who harms the innocent will be punished, wherever they hide.
aicompanion.tv.kira4: Honest people have nothing to fear. Live in peace.
aicompanion.tv.kira5: This is the new world. A world without evil.
aicompanion.show.k_end: Kira's address went out on every screen in the world. In the villages they are already raising shrines to him.
aicompanion.worship.rumour1: Kira punished the raiders who burned our fields. Kira is justice!
aicompanion.worship.rumour2: My grandmother lights a candle for Kira every night now.
aicompanion.worship.rumour3: Since Kira came, the bandits are gone. I sleep with the door open.
aicompanion.worship.rumour4: Some say Kira is a god. I say: thank god for Kira.
aicompanion.fear.rumour1: Kira killed an innocent... who's next? Any of us?
aicompanion.fear.rumour2: Don't say his name. Don't even think about Kira.
aicompanion.fear.rumour3: That's no justice. That's a monster with a pen.
aicompanion.worship.shrine: The villagers have built a shrine to Kira (%s, %s): candles, flowers and a barrel for offerings.
aicompanion.worship.letter1: Dear Kira, thank you for punishing the raiders. Please watch over our village.
aicompanion.worship.letter2: Kira, we bring you apples. We hope they please you. Your faithful.
aicompanion.tv.kingdom1: Sakura TV presents Kira's Kingdom! Tonight: another villain judged. Kira is justice!
aicompanion.tv.kingdom2: Kira's Kingdom: our viewers write in. "Kira, please judge the bandits of my village!"
aicompanion.tv.kingdom3: Kira's Kingdom: the streets have never been safer. Coincidence? We think not!
aicompanion.tv.kingdom4: Kira's Kingdom: a message to Kira from all of us. We are with you!
aicompanion.sidoh.chocolate: Ch-chocolate! For me? Mmm... you're not so bad, for a human.
aicompanion.hurt.investigator: Hey! What do you think you're doing?!
aicompanion.msg.key_refused: Ryuk is silent: the key was turned away.
aicompanion.msg.limit: Ryuk has talked himself out for today: the free Groq daily limit is used up. He'll talk again tomorrow, or paste another key.
aicompanion.msg.offline: Ryuk is silent: no connection to Groq. Check the internet.
aicompanion.setup.title: SETTING UP RYUK
aicompanion.setup.intro: To talk, Ryuk needs a key to an AI. Groq is the easiest: free, and a minute's work. Another AI can be picked above.
aicompanion.setup.step1: 1. Press "Open the key site" below and sign in with Google or GitHub.
aicompanion.setup.step2: 2. Press "Create API Key", give it any name and copy the key (it starts with gsk_).
aicompanion.setup.step3: 3. Come back here and press "Paste": the key checks itself.
aicompanion.setup.empty: Paste the key into the field.
aicompanion.setup.works: The key works (%s models). Ryuk is ready.
aicompanion.setup.refused: The key was turned away. Copy all of it.
aicompanion.setup.limit: The key is right, but today's limit is used up.
aicompanion.setup.offline: No connection: the key is saved, check your internet.
aicompanion.setup.private: The key stays on this computer (config/aicompanion-common.toml) and goes only to the AI you picked.
aicompanion.setup.server: You're on a server: Ryuk follows the server's config. Here go your own key and voice (speech recognition, Orpheus).
aicompanion.card.hint_news: His name and face were on TV: that's all the notebook needs.
aicompanion.card.note_text: Something black fell from the sky right next to you. Pick it up.
aicompanion.card.ryuk_text: A god of death. He was bored, so he dropped his notebook into the human world. Now it's yours.
aicompanion.card.hq_text: L has invited you over. He wants to look Kira in the face.
aicompanion.card.l_dead_text: You beat the world's greatest detective. But L had successors...
aicompanion.card.sidoh_text: Another god of death has lost his notebook, and a mafia gang has it. Their hideout is out there.
aicompanion.card.near_text: L's successor has taken the case. His people, the SPK, are waiting at their base.
aicompanion.card.box_text: Near is waiting for Kira at the warehouse at dawn. It all ends there.
aicompanion.card.shrine_text: In a village people have built a shrine to Kira, and they bring him apples.
aicompanion.errand.cameras: Ryuk flew off through the walls to look for L's cameras...
aicompanion.errand.cameras_found: Ryuk is back: %s cameras, %s of L's people. Glowing for 30 s.
aicompanion.errand.cameras_none: Ryuk is back: no cameras and none of L's people nearby.
aicompanion.errand.scout: Ryuk flew off to look around...
aicompanion.errand.scout_back: Ryuk is back from his look around.
aicompanion.card.why.time: Your lifespan has run out. Forty seconds.
aicompanion.card.why.own_name: You wrote your own name. Forty seconds.
aicompanion.card.why.caught: L proved you are Kira. Forty seconds.
aicompanion.card.why.bored: Ryuk got bored with you. Forty seconds.
aicompanion.card.not_final: Without his game, you'll be back.
aicompanion.warn.suspicion: L's suspicion of you: %s%%. At 100%% you're arrested. Keep the notebook out of sight and lie low.
aicompanion.warn.bored: Ryuk is bored: %s%%. An apple or a good show would cheer him up.
aicompanion.warn.bored_pact: Ryuk is bored: %s%%. At 100%% he writes your name, by his game. An apple or a good show would cheer him up.
aicompanion.way.none: Ryuk: nowhere to go right now. Watch the news, write names, and wait for the next move.
aicompanion.eyelook.depth_tip: On top: the glow on the hat layer, over glasses and hair. Inset: a pixel deeper, on the face itself, for skins whose second layer has relief around the eyes.
aicompanion.setup.about.openai: OpenAI (GPT): paid, a little for every line (usually a fraction of a cent). It takes an API key; a ChatGPT subscription won't do.
aicompanion.setup.about.claude: Claude (Anthropic): paid, a little for every line. It takes an API key from the Anthropic console; a Claude subscription won't do.
aicompanion.setup.about.gemini: Gemini (Google): there's a free tier, about 100 lines a day. The key is made in Google AI Studio in a minute.
aicompanion.setup.about.openrouter: OpenRouter: one key to many models (GPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek and more). Paid per line; some models are free.
aicompanion.setup.about.custom: Any server in the OpenAI format: a model of your own on this computer through Ollama or LM Studio, say. The key may stay empty.
aicompanion.setup.steps_any: Open the site with the button below, create an API key, copy it and press Paste: it checks itself. The model is picked for you; change it in the settings.
aicompanion.setup.steps_custom: Type the address (.../v1/chat/completions), a key if it wants one, and press Check. Then name the model in the settings.
aicompanion.voice.needs_groq: Voice needs a free Groq key: /ryuk → Settings
aicompanion.voice.key_refused: The voice key didn't work: /ryuk → check the key
aicompanion.tv.died_how: Breaking: %s, the wanted man, is dead: %s.
aicompanion.tv.place1: in a rented flat in the harbour district
aicompanion.tv.place2: in an abandoned warehouse by the river
aicompanion.tv.place5: on the roof of a shopping mall
aicompanion.tv.place6: in his own car in a night-time car park
aicompanion.tv.place7: in the seaside house where he was hiding
aicompanion.tv.place8: in a forest cabin outside the city
aicompanion.tv.story.heart1: Breaking: %1$s, wanted for %2$s, has been found dead %3$s. Doctors are baffled: his heart simply stopped. Online, one word again: "Kira".
aicompanion.tv.story.heart2: %1$s, wanted for %2$s, clutched his chest and dropped dead %3$s. Witnesses say he was laughing a second before.
aicompanion.tv.story.heart3: Police confirm: %1$s is dead. The man wanted for %2$s was found %3$s. A heart attack, yet another this month.
aicompanion.tv.story.fire1: Breaking: a fire %3$s. A body inside: %1$s, wanted for %2$s. The blaze started in a locked room, and nobody can say how.
aicompanion.tv.story.fire2: %1$s, wanted for %2$s, burned to death %3$s. Neighbours heard a scream, and a minute later everything was in flames. Firefighters say it started by itself.
aicompanion.tv.story.fire3: A night fire %3$s: %1$s, wanted for %2$s, is dead. Investigators are looking for an arsonist, but there are no traces, inside or out.
aicompanion.tv.story.fall1: Breaking: %1$s, wanted for %2$s, fell to his death; he was found %3$s. Witnesses swear he simply stepped off.
aicompanion.tv.story.fall2: %1$s, wanted for %2$s, died in a fall. He was last seen %3$s, walking to the edge without looking back.
aicompanion.tv.story.fall3: A strange death %3$s: %1$s, wanted for %2$s, fell from a height with nobody near and the railings intact.
aicompanion.tv.story.lightning1: Breaking: lightning out of a clear sky. %1$s, wanted for %2$s, was killed on the spot %3$s. Forecasters can't remember anything like it.
aicompanion.tv.story.lightning2: %1$s, wanted for %2$s, was struck by lightning %3$s. The storm came out of nowhere, struck once and was gone.
aicompanion.tv.story.lightning3: One bolt, and %1$s is dead. The man wanted for %2$s was found %3$s; there was no other sign of a storm in the city.
aicompanion.tv.story.drown1: Breaking: %1$s, wanted for %2$s, drowned %3$s, far from any water. Experts can't explain it.
aicompanion.tv.story.drown2: %1$s, wanted for %2$s, was found dead %3$s: water in his lungs, everything around him dry. Police have sealed the details.
aicompanion.tv.story.drown3: Mystery on the news: %1$s drowned without going near the water. The man wanted for %2$s was found %3$s.
aicompanion.tv.story.blast1: Breaking: an explosion %3$s. Dead: %1$s, wanted for %2$s. Bomb squads found no bomb and no gas.
aicompanion.tv.story.blast2: %1$s, wanted for %2$s, was killed in a blast %3$s. Witnesses say it went off out of nowhere, right where he stood.
aicompanion.tv.story.blast3: A blast %3$s: %1$s, wanted for %2$s, is dead. Nobody else was hurt, as if it knew whom to look for.
aicompanion.tv.story.freeze1: Breaking: %1$s, wanted for %2$s, froze to death %3$s, on a warm day in a warm room.
aicompanion.tv.story.freeze2: %1$s, wanted for %2$s, was found %3$s covered in frost. Medics speak of hypothermia, in the middle of a heatwave.
aicompanion.tv.story.freeze3: An icy death: %1$s froze %3$s. The man wanted for %2$s was found sitting, as if he had just fallen asleep.
aicompanion.tv.story.sickness1: Breaking: %1$s, wanted for %2$s, died of a sudden illness %3$s. Healthy in the morning, dead by evening.
aicompanion.tv.story.sickness2: %1$s, wanted for %2$s, died %3$s before the doctors could even name what he had.
aicompanion.tv.story.sickness3: A one-man epidemic: %1$s died %3$s. The man wanted for %2$s was struck by an illness nobody can identify.
aicompanion.tv.story.how1: Breaking: %1$s, wanted for %2$s, is dead. Witnesses describe it like this: "%3$s". Police are checking every detail, and it all adds up.
aicompanion.tv.story.how2: An incredible death: %1$s, wanted for %2$s: "%3$s". Investigators say it couldn't have been staged.
aicompanion.tv.story.how3: %1$s, wanted for %2$s, is dead. Details from the police: "%3$s". Online, people are already whispering it was Kira.
aicompanion.show.name: LIND L. TAILOR
aicompanion.show.role: calls himself L · an address to Kira
aicompanion.show.end: The caption said Lind L. Tailor. The whole region saw his face and name, and he's on air a few minutes more. Right-click with your TV to watch again.

aicompanion.cine.realm.title: THE REALM OF THE GODS OF DEATH
aicompanion.cine.realm.sub: No living soul comes here. You are dreaming.

aicompanion.cine.god.gamblers.title: GOOK AND DERIDOVELY

aicompanion.dice.title: Chō-han
aicompanion.dice.hint_open: [Enter] roll · wheel or ↑↓ stake · Esc leave
aicompanion.dice.no_apples: Nothing to stake: you need plain apples.
aicompanion.dice.say.hi1: Heh heh... A game? Even or odd, all fair and square.
aicompanion.dice.say.hi2: Put your apples down, human. Dice don't lie.
aicompanion.dice.say.hi3: Gook never stood a chance against me. Let's see about you.
aicompanion.dice.say.hi4: Chō-han. Two dice, one cup, and your apples.
aicompanion.dice.say.win3: Fine, fine. They're yours. For now.
aicompanion.dice.say.eyes1: Two sixes! Shinigami eyes! Triple, take it, you earned it.
aicompanion.dice.say.snake1: Snake eyes! All mine, heh heh heh!
aicompanion.dice.say.broke1: Out of apples. Come back when you're rich.
item.aicompanion.sidoh_page.desc: Someone else's notebook. Touching it lets you see its god of death. Writing in it is out of the question.
item.aicompanion.sidoh_bandage.desc: Wound round the head, it hides the face: no one reads your name off it, not even with the eyes.
aicompanion.quest.page_text: A page of a black notebook comes swaying down out of the sky. It isn't yours. Catch it (right click).
aicompanion.quest.sidoh_text: Sidoh, the clumsiest god of death, has scattered his notebook's pages. The wind took %s more. Find them: the arrow shows the nearest, and they dodge.
aicompanion.quest.gust: A gust snatches the page away!
aicompanion.quest.give_back: All the pages are here. Give them to Sidoh: right click on him.
aicompanion.quest.sidoh_done_text: Sidoh has his pages back, and you have his spare bandage: wear it on your head and your face can't be read.
aicompanion.case.q_sidoh_first: • A stranger's page is falling from the sky: catch it
aicompanion.case.q_sidoh_back: • Sidoh's pages: all %s of %s, give them back to Sidoh
aicompanion.quest.realm_text: Ryuk offers to show you the realm of the gods of death, in a dream. Give him a golden apple and go to bed while he's near.
aicompanion.quest.realm_in: The Realm of the Gods of Death
aicompanion.quest.realm_in_text: %s sights here: a window to the humans, the dice game of Gook and Deridovely, Armonia on his throne, the King in his chains, the dead tree. Each has a sign over it; the arrow shows the nearest. Jump into a hole and you wake up.
aicompanion.quest.realm_again: %s more to see in Ryuk's world. Again: a golden apple for Ryuk, then sleep.
aicompanion.quest.realm_done: The Realm of the Gods of Death: done
aicompanion.quest.realm_done_text: You've seen all of Ryuk's world and get why he was bored there. You know more about the gods of death than anyone alive.
aicompanion.quest.king_text: Bring %s apples into the dream and put them in the bowl at the King's feet. Over several dreams is fine.
aicompanion.quest.king_life: The King gave back the years you paid for the eyes. That has never happened before.
aicompanion.quest.king_eyes: The King granted you the eyes of a god of death, for nothing: not a day of your life taken.
aicompanion.sight.window_how: Window to the humans: right-click the lodestone on its rim
aicompanion.sight.bones_how: Dice game: apple in hand, right-click the bowl between Gook and Deridovely
aicompanion.sight.armonia_how: Armonia on his throne: right-click to talk
aicompanion.sight.apple_how: The dead tree: right-click its trunk
aicompanion.sight.tribute: The tribute bowl at the King's feet: right-click with apples
aicompanion.case.q_realm_first: • Ryuk's world: a golden apple for Ryuk, then sleep
aicompanion.case.q_realm: • The realm: %s of %s seen (again: a golden apple and sleep)
aicompanion.case.q_realm_done: • The realm of the gods of death: done ✓
aicompanion.case.q_king: • Tribute to the King: %s of %s apples in the bowl
aicompanion.sidoh.q.hello: Y-you can see me?! You touched my page... Please, help! I dropped them again, the wind took them, if Armonia finds out...
aicompanion.sidoh.q.got1: That's one! Oh, thank you, thank you!
aicompanion.sidoh.q.got3: Another one! There aren't many left!
aicompanion.sidoh.q.all: All of them! Give them here, quick, before Ryuk laughs at me again...
aicompanion.sidoh.q.short: There aren't five... Did you lose one? Oh no, oh no...
aicompanion.sidoh.q.thanks: Thank you! Here, take my spare bandage: wind it round your head and nobody can read your name off your face, not even with the eyes. And... don't tell Armonia, all right?
aicompanion.sidoh.q.hint: Th-there! I saw it fly that way!
aicompanion.sidoh.q.line1: Hurry, please... the wind is getting up.
aicompanion.sidoh.q.line2: Ryuk is laughing at me again, isn't he?
aicompanion.sidoh.q.line3: If the King finds out I lost them twice...
aicompanion.sidoh.q.line4: I'm scared of humans. Not you. Well, a little you.
aicompanion.sidoh.q.line5: Do you have any chocolate? For chocolate I remember things.
aicompanion.sidoh.q.line6: They glow a bit. Look for the glow.
aicompanion.sidoh.realm.hello_stranger: Oh! A h-human?! Here?.. Ah, it's a dream. Don't be scared. I mean... I'm the one who's scared.
aicompanion.sidoh.realm.hello_helper: It's you! You're gathering my pages, aren't you? Please don't give up!
aicompanion.sidoh.realm.hello_friend: It's you! The human who brought my pages back! I was waiting for you, honest.
aicompanion.sidoh.realm.stranger1: I'm Sidoh. I watch the human world down there, in case I spot my notebook. I keep losing it...
aicompanion.sidoh.realm.stranger2: If a black page ever falls out of the sky in your world, it's mine! Catch it, please.
aicompanion.sidoh.realm.stranger3: Just don't tell Armonia I lost something again. He writes everything down.
aicompanion.sidoh.realm.stranger4: Ryuk laughs at everyone, and at me most of all. You're with him, aren't you?
aicompanion.sidoh.realm.helper1: Not all the pages yet? Oh... the wind carried them all over your world.
aicompanion.sidoh.realm.helper2: They glow a little. Look for the glow, and follow Ryuk's arrow.
aicompanion.sidoh.realm.helper3: If the King finds out I lost them twice... Please find them!
aicompanion.sidoh.realm.helper4: If you have chocolate, give it to me in your world. For chocolate I remember where a page flew.
aicompanion.sidoh.realm.friend1: Thank you for my pages, human! I count them every day. All there!
aicompanion.sidoh.realm.friend2: Still wearing the bandage? Good. While it's on, nobody reads your name off your face.
aicompanion.sidoh.realm.friend3: Armonia never found out. Shh! It's our secret.
aicompanion.sidoh.realm.friend4: Want a secret? Ryuk's notebook has rules that... oops. I didn't say anything!
aicompanion.sidoh.realm.notebook1: You got my notebook back from that scary man. I'll never forget it.
aicompanion.sidoh.realm.notebook2: Now I never let it out of my claws. Well... almost.
aicompanion.realm.label.window: A hole down to the human world
aicompanion.realm.label.window_how: right-click the lodestone: see where people are
aicompanion.realm.label.dice_how: apple in hand, right-click the bowl
aicompanion.realm.label.tree_how: right-click the trunk: an apple of the realm
aicompanion.realm.label.tribute_how: 13 apples: right-click with apples in hand
